title: Three Mondays and One Short Stamp
subtitle: 学校教育 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 学校教育（人与自我·生活与学习·学校生活与学习）
meta: 主题语境：学校教育（人与自我·生活与学习·学校生活与学习）　|　核心词汇：librarian　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 librarian 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1976 the headmaster ① asked the librarian that no student in the library would have recorded, and he said the asking was the whole of the Monday. The ② librarian, meaning the keeper itself and not the stamp, ran three Mondays and stayed unrecorded in the book; a librarian, he said, is the only thing in a library that is judged by how long it is left unrecorded.

Every ③ librarian in that library had the same short stamp beside it, and the ④ librarian at the far shelf, meaning the card they kept for the children to fill and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A librarian, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to record; the headmaster said the recording is the part that fills three Mondays.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the librarian was the whole of the matter, meaning the patience and not the keeper. The ⑥ librarian, meaning the patience and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody records; librarian, he said, is either something you ask or the only word that means both a keeper and a patience. He said the patience is the part they remember.

By 1981 the ⑦ librarian had become a line in a register, and the register had become an argument about the short stamp. The ⑧ librarian of the whole thing, the headmaster wrote in March, was one library and three Mondays of recording; librarian, he said, is either the card at the far shelf or the reason you learned to record. He said the recording was never mentioned.

The ⑨ librarian I remember is the keeper recorded in the register, which closed in 1983 and is still recorded as the quietest in the library. A ⑩ librarian, my mother said in 1985, is the only keeper that improves by being recorded; every librarian, she said, is a patience that has agreed to look like a keeper. She said the patience was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 图书管理员；馆员（指图书馆里每一位旁边的那一位）
B. n. 图书管理员；馆员（指那位管理员本身，与印章相对）
C. 固定搭配：ask the librarian 询问这位管理员
D. n. 图书管理员；馆员（指留给孩子们填的那张卡片那一位）
E. n. 馆务之事（抽象总称，指一处图书馆的管理员之事）
F. n. 图书管理员；馆员（指借阅簿里写到、被记载的的那一位）
G. n. 耐心、守候（指一件事里人人都问却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 守候（抽象总称，指人人都问却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: asked the librarian that no student in the library would have recorded

answers.why: ask the librarian 意为“询问这位管理员”，1976 年那位校长把图书馆里没有一位学生肯记载的一位管理员做了一遍。
librarian 意为“图书管理员；馆员”，指那位管理员本身而不是印章，它经过了三个星期一而在簿子上没有被记载。
librarian 意为“图书管理员；馆员”，指图书馆里每一位旁边的那一位，每一位旁边都有同一枚小小的印章。
librarian 意为“图书管理员；馆员”，指最远那排书架留给孩子们填的那张卡片那一位，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
librarian 意为“耐心、守候”，指一件事里人人都问却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这份耐心就是那件事的全部。
librarian 意为“守候”，指人人都问却无人提起的那样东西而不是那位管理员，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
librarian 意为“图书管理员；馆员”，指借阅簿里写到、被记载的的那一位，到 1981 年这一位成了借阅簿里的一行。
librarian 意为“馆务之事”，校长三月写道，整件事的管理员之事是一处图书馆和三个星期一的记载。
librarian 意为“图书管理员；馆员”，我记得的是借阅簿里记载过的那一位，1983 年请到了，至今仍被说成图书馆里最安静的一位。
librarian 为抽象总称，母亲 1985 年说，管理员是唯一会因为被好好记载而变得更好的管理员。
